saves.source: RetroArch 1.22.2: frontend/drivers/platform_unix.c:1670-1694 (Android default save and state folders: <internal storage>/RetroArch/saves and states, else Android/data/<pkg>/files), configuration.c:4418-4424 (savefile_directory; "default" means that folder), runloop.c:8205-8265 (with the folder unset the file sits in the content's folder; sort_savefiles_enable, on by default per config.def.h:917, adds a folder named for the core's library), runloop.c:4211 and :8148 (.srm)
